items.content_html: GeoViz is a lightweight, browser-based toolkit for visualizing and analyzing geophysical survey data. It supports both VLF and Resistivity profiles with automatic apparent resistivity calculation, multiple array configurations, and Karous-Hjelt filtering. No server required—just paste your data and visualize instantly. Open source under MIT License
